name: The Cozy Caverns
description: A vast underground mountain network housing multiple biome caverns
fullDescription: The Cozy Caverns is a massive mountain-spanning cave system that serves as a full progression journey for miners and adventurers. Each deeper region introduces new dangers, resources, and lore, culminating in the gateway to the Darklands.

name: Crystal Caverns
description: The first main area of the Cozy Caverns, rich with vibrant gemstones
fullDescription: Crystal Caverns is the first true mining region explorers encounter after entering the Cozy Caverns. Glittering walls and crystal growths illuminate the path, providing essential early-game materials.

name: Industrial Caverns
description: A mechanized cavern lined with dense metals and magnetic stone
fullDescription: The Industrial Caverns mark a shift from gemstone mining to heavy metallurgy. The air hums with magnetic energy and the walls are reinforced with dense alloys.

name: Lush Hollows
description: A living cavern overtaken by growth, slime, and bio-energy
fullDescription: The Lush Hollows pulse with life. Bioluminescent flora coats the cavern floor, and viscous growths cling to the walls. The environment feels alive — and watching.

name: Volcanic Depths
description: Molten tunnels forged by ancient volcanic pressure
fullDescription: The Volcanic Depths are blisteringly hot caverns carved by lava flows. The air scorches unprotected explorers, and the ore itself burns to the touch.

name: Icy Heights
description: Frozen caverns suspended in eternal ice
fullDescription: Icy Heights is a glacial cavern where frost magic dominates. Every step slows the unprepared, and the cold seeps into armor and bone alike.

name: Abyssal Maw
description: The final chamber of the Cozy Caverns and gateway to the Darklands

stats.Requirement: Gear that emits a bright aura

fullDescription: The Abyssal Maw is a void-like cavern that swallows all light. At its heart lies the portal to the Darklands. Only those bearing radiant gear may proceed.

sections.title: Special Requirements
content: Requires gear that emits a bright aura

name: Merlin's Cove
description: A secluded sanctuary housing the recently awakened Merlin
fullDescription: Merlin's Cove is a hidden refuge nestled between the Icy Heights and the Abyssal Maw. Here resides Merlin, recently awakened from a long slumber. He serves as a guide to the Darklands and the catalyst for the legendary Daylight & Eclipse questline.

sections.title: Merlin the Awoken
content: Hear tales of Kangijarr the Courageous
